content:
ana: Quick sync — need to land SOC2 retention and egress rules for Q3 roadmap. I dropped a rough spec in the doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/retention-egress-draft
mike: looking now. main blockers from infra side are HSM availability for key wrapping and per-tenant export windows.
sarah: from legal: retention min/max by region pls. EU has stricter reqs, also need legal-hold flow for subpoenas.
jordan: can we define fallback if HSM is down? auto-rotate to software-wrapped keys sounds risky.
mike: agreed — proposal: primary KMS/HSM with automatic failover to a separate KMS cluster (audit-only mode), plus alerting. fallback must be cryptographically auditable.
eli: for product/roadmap: customers keep asking for per-tenant retention settings and an easy export/eraser API. We should scope MVP: per-tenant retention + manual export job, postpone self-service erasure to next quarter.
ana: @eli typo — ana
ana: @eli noted. timeline constraint: we must ship baseline before SOC2 audit in mid-Q3.
mike: acceptance criteria idea:
```
- encrypted-at-rest with HSM/KMS
- per-tenant retention configurable (30/90/365/forever)
- audit logs for retention changes and exports
- legal-hold toggle that pauses erasure for a tenant
```
sarah: add: retention policy defaults and overrides documented, plus examplar DSR flow for privacy audit.
jordan: ops requirements:
- export job throttling and TTL on exported archives
- per-tenant export audit event with sha256 checksum
- rollout plan: canary on non-prod, blue/green for prod
mike: cost/infra tradeoff: HSM-backed envelopes per request is expensive. suggest envelope encryption with long-lived envelope keys rotated weekly; HSM signs rotations.
eli: product tradeoff: that saves $$$ but increases complexity for legal/forensics. need to document how to prove key lineage.
ana: owners: mike (sec-eng) for KMS/HSM work, jordan for export/ops, sarah for legal acceptance, eli for product acceptance. Can we get rough ETA?
mike: I can do prototype for envelope rotation + audit logs in 3 sprints (6 weeks).
jordan: export/ops work 2 sprints (4 weeks) after prototype. will need one on-call runbook.
sarah: legal review and DSR doc — 2 weeks concurrent with prototype.
eli: so end-to-end MVP around 8-10 weeks if we parallelize. Add buffer for SOC2 prep.
ana: OK — I'll add to roadmap draft and link to OKRs: security:SOC2-ready and product:per-tenant-retention-MVP. Moving to sprint planning doc.
deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] staging rollout for retention-api v0.1 at 2025-07-12T02:00Z :rocket:
mike: ping @ana — can you confirm SLA for retention-change audit log retention? we need retention of those logs for 1 year for auditability.
ana: confirmed: audit logs kept 1 year by default, longer if enterprise plan requests it.
eli: next steps: 1) finalize spec doc, 2) add JIRA epics (mike/jordan), 3) schedule legal review (sarah), 4) add to Q3 roadmap snapshot.
mike: I'll create the KMS epic and link prototype PR. jordan will create export epic.
sarah: I'll post required legal text by EOD Friday.
ana: thanks all. I'll update the thread with the final acceptance criteria and call out non-go items. :thumbsup:
